description: Authenticates email that Charchy sends from a customer's own domain through Amazon SES. Group 'dkim' adds the three Easy DKIM CNAMEs. Group 'dmarc' adds a monitoring-only DMARC policy and is only requested when the domain has no DMARC record yet. Supports the zone apex and subdomains (via host).
variableDescription: dkim1, dkim2, dkim3: the three Amazon SES Easy DKIM tokens of the customer's sending domain (lowercase letters and digits). The CNAME targets are fixed to <token>.dkim.amazonses.com.
